// A perspective camera authored by aiming: positioned at Position, looking at
// Target, with Up resolving the roll about the view axis.
type LookAtCamera
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Target: Point3D;
    Up: Direction3D;
    VerticalFov: Angle;
    AspectRatio: Number;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
